title: File:United States Capitol - west front.jpg
desc: The western front of the United States Capitol. The Neoclassical style building is in Washington, D.C., on Capitol Hill, at the east end of the National Mall. The Capitol was designated a National Historic Landmark in 1960.

title: File:2018-03-25 – United States Capitol West Front, viewed from the Newseum terrace – Washington, D.C., United States.jpg
desc: The United States Capitol's West Front in Washington, D.C., United States, viewed from the Hank Greenspun Terrace of the Newseum. Pennsylvania Avenue extends toward the Capitol in the foreground, with the Peace Monument visible near the Capitol grounds.
